text: Here's how to make reels like this with Claude Code.
It looks hard. It's only five steps!
One. Drop my skill folder into Claude Code.
Two. Ask it to check your setup. It installs what's missing.
Three. Type one line, like: why does airport water cost $8?
Four. Hit enter and walk away.
It writes the script, voices it, animates each scene and times the captions.
Then it scores its own cut and fixes the weak spots.
Five. Post it, then make another one tomorrow.
That's how my channel hit 9.2M views in 28 days, without filming a thing.
Comment SYSTEM and I'll send it to you.
